name: firmanfarel-portfolio-workspace
description: Workspace orchestrator for Firman Farel Personal Portfolio & CMS

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
